title: AI Conversation
description: Practice Chinese with the character, correction style, and AI runtime you choose. The character profile is saved on this device; conversation content remains in the current session only.
greeting: 你好，我是{name}。I am in “{role}” mode. Start in Chinese or tell me your goal for this practice session.

runtime.label: AI runtime
runtime.description: Choose a specific key when you want to know exactly which provider/model will be called. Automatic mode uses the highest-priority enabled key and does not silently switch to another key when a request fails.
runtime.loadError: Could not load API keys. Automatic mode can still be used.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: 例如：今天下班以后我想练习聊日常生活。
message.hint: Ctrl/Cmd + Enter to send · AI keeps up to 20 recent messages plus the stable memory profile.

setup.title: Conversation character setup
setup.description: Choose the role, correction intensity, and details AI should remember. This profile is stored only in the browser on this device.
setup.interestsPlaceholder: Example: life in China, films, work, eating out, travel…
setup.characterNotesPlaceholder: Example: speak like a peer and occasionally use common colloquial expressions without overusing slang.
setup.memoryNotesDescription: This is sent again on every turn so core learner context survives long conversations.
setup.memoryNotesPlaceholder: Example: I am around HSK4, struggle with word order and Vietnamese → Chinese translation, and prefer Mainland Mandarin usage.
